meta.name: treasury-and-liquidity
meta.description: Manages cash and liquidity — cash forecasting, runway, working capital, banking structure, and currency and counterparty exposure. Use this to build a cash forecast, extend runway, improve working capital, decide where cash should sit, or assess exposure to a bank, currency, or customer concentration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理现金流动，预测资金余缺
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果公司需要掌握现金余缺、规划资金使用
copy.tagline_en: Manage cash positions, forecast liquidity, and reduce exposure risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to forecast cash and plan liquidity across banks and currencies

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按实际收付款时点搭建 13 周直接现金预测,每周对照上周预测与实际结果;也会按基准、下行、大额应收延迟情景计算 runway,标出融资和降本的决策日期,并评估现金存放与集中度风险。
howto.when: 当你说要搭现金预测、算 runway、改善营运资金等流动性话题时触发;涉及银行或客户集中度、对手方风险时也会接管。

say.text: 帮我做未来13周的直接现金预测,按周列收款和付款
say.note: 会生成按周收付款的预测表

say.text: 给出悲观情景下的 runway 和必须开始融资的日期
say.note: 返回带下行情景的 runway 与决策点

say.text: 分析应收账款账龄趋势,看哪些客户拖慢现金回收
say.note: 提示争议发票与账龄异常

howto.what_en: Claude builds a 13-week direct cash forecast from actual receipt/payment timing, compares past forecasts with actuals, models runway under base/downside/late-receivable scenarios, sets decision dates, and advises on cash placement and concentration risk.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a cash forecast, runway, working capital improvement, or related liquidity topics; also for bank/currency/customer exposure assessment.

say_en.text: Build me a 13-week direct cash forecast with weekly receipts and payments.
Runway under a pessimistic case, and the latest date to start fundraising.
say_en.note: Returns a downside runway with decision date.

say_en.text: Analyze receivables aging trends to find customers who slow cash collection.
say_en.note: Flags disputed invoices or aging anomalies.
